question.text: Custodians in the cash segment settle trades on behalf of:

answer.text: Their institutional clients, which are executed through other trading members

explanation.text: The Logic: Custodians act as clearing members (not trading members) and settle cash-segment trades on behalf of their institutional clients that are executed through other trading members. The Trap: Treating custodians as trading members or as serving retail/proprietary/foreign-only clients does not match the source role. Note: The custodian's role is defined as clearing-member settlement for institutional client trades routed via other trading members.
